first.rationale: The immediate competitive loss is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, where inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing can lift acquisition and revenue. A small, guarded segment-specific test is warranted before broad use because discounting may reduce long-term value or attract lower-quality customers. Onboarding is also being verified as a potentially stronger durable alternative given concurrent completion and activation declines.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and likely contributes to the 6% activation decline, while verified evidence shows higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%). This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing: the verified discount test increased signups and short-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12% and explicitly should not be generalized as a sustainable-growth strategy.
